uncited: BasicDAGColorsBase is the foundational family for managing color data within Sparse Voxel DAG structures.
It solves the problem of decoupling leaf count storage from the primary geometry data, ensuring that color metadata remains consistent with the hierarchical structure.

It differs from sibling methods by establishing the base array layout for enclosed leaf counts, whereas [BasicDAGUncompressedColors](6741-basicdaguncompressedcolors.md) focuses on raw storage and [Mixture Graph](11065-mixture-graph.md) introduces mixture-based color representations.
The core mechanism relies on an `enclosedLeaves` array to determine the number of leaves, which dictates the scope of subsequent operations such as color error computation or compression.
This structure decouples leaf count storage from the main geometry array.
This structure ensures that the leaf count is explicitly tracked and accessible for any child class that requires per-leaf processing, such as error calculation or color blending.
The concept originates from the HashDAG implementation, which utilizes a directed acyclic graph structure for volume geometry.
The specific color base class was developed to manage color data efficiently within this sparse voxel framework.
